  does not claim, so they are corroborated rather than wrong. They are not scored as true positives

  ENUMERATES as failing, and criteria the statement is merely silent about. Both are
  non-accusations, so FALSE POSITIVES is exact either way, but a disclosed failure is a positive
  label we are discarding. See `claimDiscloses` in real-page-corpus.mjs.
